title: 2016 AMC 8 Problem 13
statement: Two different numbers are randomly selected from the set \[\{ - 2, -1, 0, 3, 4, 5\}\] and multiplied together. What is the probability that the product is \(0?\)

solutions.text:
There are \(\binom62=15\) ways to select two different numbers. A product is \(0\) exactly when one selected number is \(0\), and there are \(5\) choices for the other number. Thus the probability is \(\dfrac5{15}=\dfrac13.\)

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: A product is \(0\) exactly when one of the selected numbers is \(0\).
Count selections containing \(0\) out of all ways to choose two different numbers.
